C0787.title: State Security Exposes Spy Operation Using Tampered Shared Power Banks to Implant Backdoors
C0787.summary: In late July 2025, national security agencies uncovered a spy operation exploiting supply chain gaps in the production, sale, and deployment of shared power banks. Miniature chips or spyware were embedded inside the devices, enabling a data channel within seconds of connecting to a phone.
